name: scroll-completion
title: Scroll Completion
description: Programmatic scroll completion utilities. Platform Reference: Modern Web Guidance (MWG: scroll-completion-effects) Awaits the native Promise returned by `scrollIntoView()` / `scrollTo()` when supported, and falls back to `scrollend` with an idle-scroll timer on browsers where scroll methods return `undefined`. Prevents premature focus shifts or post-scroll highlights mid-animation.
